g.aria-label: What Visual Inspection (data.visualize) Catches vs. Misses
1. Label Offsets & Spatial Transposes [Caught by eye]
Off-by-one class names ("trouser" on a boot) or sideways rotated garments
2. Channel Scrambling or Sign Inversion [Caught by eye]
White background (1 − X) instead of dark background (0) is obvious
imshow auto-scales [vmin, vmax] while unscaled pixels blow up logits 255×!
